daily.title: French embassy in Riyadh tells citizens to avoid Saudi airports targeted by Houthis
daily.summary: France's embassy in Saudi Arabia told its citizens to avoid the airports in Riyadh, Jeddah and Dammam on Tuesday as fighting escalates between a Saudi-led coalition and Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi rebels, who have been attacking Saudi airports and oil facilities since last week.

Depuis Israël, ce Parisien avait mis en place un stratagème mêlant ingénierie sociale et cybercriminalité afin de détourner des fonds de cabinets de notaires et d’entreprises.
